name: superframes-edit
description: SuperFrames Edit — one skill for the whole AI video pipeline. Build the film as code (HyperFrames HTML or Remotion React), animate motion graphics, cut and mix with FFmpeg, download and analyse references with yt-dlp, verify frame by frame, and export delivery masters. Merges HeyGen HyperFrames, Remotion, FFmpeg and yt-dlp into one contract.
